Add the new API in alongside the old one so that things can be migrated incrementally. The patch file is a subset of the patch committed to chromium/src as 411f4fc60df3. chromeos-dbus-bindings: use ScopedTempDir::GetPath Upstream versions of libchrome have gotten rid of ScopedTempDir's inline path method because they wanted to introduce a DCHECK that helps make sure people create the temp directory before using it. To avoid introducing a header dependency on the logging header they took this method out of the header so it wouldn't be inlined. firmware_programmer: Implement DFU programmer to flash BaseEC DFU programmer is to trigger BaseEC to DFU mode, by setting its ec_boot_mode GPIO and resetting it, and to call the flash_ec script on DUT to flash the image. The flash_ec script is executed in DUT, instead of beaglebone (a host of the servo board). BUG=b:69160863 TEST=Ran a small script to program BaseEC: """ import common from autotest_lib.server import hosts machine = "<DUT_IP>" image = "<BASE_EC_IMAGE_PATH>" servo_args = {'servo_host': 'localhost'} host = hosts.create_host(machine, servo_args=servo_args) host.program_base_ec(image) """ Change-Id: I95c05458018fe9fdcdd699c001ee84368c760344 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/862186 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Reviewed-by: Nicolas Boichat <drinkcat@chromium.org>

cellular: add shill_context.AllowedTechnologiesContext This CL adds shill_context.AllowedTechnologiesContext context manager, which replaces the soon-to-be deprecated cell_tools.OtherDeviceShutdownContext context manager. AllowedTechnologiesContext uses shill_proxy.ShillProxy instead of the deprecated flimflam.Flimflam API. Like OtherDeviceShutdownContext, AllowedTechnologiesContext provides a context that temporarily prohibits technologies, unless explicitly allowed, to be enabled. BUG=chromium:776078 TEST=Run network3g tests on a DUT with a cellular modem. Change-Id: I2900a0509a8fd311f7f6f8ca39bd49a3317ca9a0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/875555 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Ben Chan <benchan@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Eric Caruso <ejcaruso@chromium.org>

eclass-overlay: add gpio group This group will consist of users that need to export/unexport GPIOs. Since GPIOs are board-specific and we don't want to hand out access to all GPIOs for anyone in this group, further configuration to allow access from non-root users if necessary should be left to board-specific packages. The modem user will be placed in this group first since modemfwd might need to toggle GPIOs to reset modems.
